_meta.title: Sawm (Fasting)
_meta.description: Fasting in Islam and the month of Ramadan.

sawm-easy-1.question: What is the reward multiplier for good deeds according to a hadith on fasting?
options: From ten to seven hundred times
sawm-easy-1.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said that every good deed is multiplied from ten to seven hundred times, with fasting being specially rewarded by Allah.

sawm-easy-2.question: Which gate in Paradise is exclusively for those who fast?
sawm-easy-2.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) mentioned that those who fast will enter through the gate of al-Rayyan on the Day of Resurrection.

sawm-easy-3.question: What does fasting expiate according to a hadith narrated by Hudhayfah?
options: Afflictions in property, family, and neighbors
sawm-easy-3.explanation: Fasting, along with prayer and charity, expiates afflictions in property, family, and neighbors.

sawm-easy-4.question: When are the gates of mercy opened according to Abu Hurairah?
sawm-easy-4.explanation: The gates of mercy are opened, gates of Hell closed, and devils chained in Ramadan.

sawm-easy-5.question: What is the reward for fasting Ramadan and six days of Shawwal?
options: As if fasted the whole year
sawm-easy-5.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said it is like fasting the entire year.

sawm-easy-6.question: In which month did the Prophet (PBUH) fast the most besides Ramadan?
sawm-easy-6.explanation: Narrated by 'Aisha, the Prophet fasted most of Sha'ban.

sawm-easy-7.question: What are the Noble Prophet's advice for suhur according to Anas bin Malik?
options: Take it as there is blessing in it
sawm-easy-7.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) encouraged taking suhur for its blessing.

sawm-easy-8.question: What should those who fast hasten according to Sahl bin Sa'd?
sawm-easy-8.explanation: People remain on the right path as long as they hasten iftar.

sawm-easy-9.question: What if a faster forgets and eats during the day?
sawm-easy-9.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said Allah feeds him and gives him drink.

sawm-easy-10.question: On which days did the Prophet (PBUH) fast regularly besides Ramadan?
sawm-easy-10.explanation: Deeds are presented on those days, so he fasted them.

sawm-easy-11.question: What is the Night of Decree better than?
sawm-easy-11.explanation: Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.

sawm-easy-12.question: Complete the hadeeth: In it Allah has a night which is better than a thousand months; whoever...?
options: is sick is deprived of its goodness
is deprived of its goodness is indeed deprived.
is travelling is deprived of its goodness
sawm-easy-12.explanation: The Messenger of Allah said: 'There has come to you Ramadan, a blessed month, which Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has enjoined you to fast. In it the gates of heavens are opened and the gates of Hell are closed, and every devil is chained up. In it Allah has a night which is better than a thousand months; whoever is deprived of its goodness is indeed deprived.

sawm-easy-13.question: What is fasting described as in a hadith?
sawm-easy-13.explanation: Fasting is a shield against sin and fire.

sawm-easy-14.question: What should the one who is fasting say if some one begins to quarrel with him or her?
sawm-easy-14.explanation: To remind others and protect the fast.

sawm-easy-15.question: What is sweeter to Allah than musk on the Day of Judgment?
options: The breath of those who fast
Good deeds done by the pious
sawm-easy-15.explanation: The smell of the faster's mouth is better than musk.

sawm-easy-16.question: How many joyous occasions does the faster have?
sawm-easy-16.explanation: At breaking fast and meeting his Lord.

sawm-easy-17.question: What is forbidden during fasting besides food and drink?
sawm-easy-17.explanation: Allah does not need one to leave food if they don't leave sins.

sawm-easy-18.question: What month are the gates of Heaven opened?
sawm-easy-18.explanation: Gates of Heaven opened, Hell closed in Ramadan.

sawm-easy-19.question: What is the perpetual fast?
sawm-easy-19.explanation: Three days every month and Ramadan is perpetual.

sawm-easy-20.question: What day expiates sins of two years?
sawm-easy-20.explanation: Fasting Arafah expiates the sins of the preceding and coming year.

sawm-easy-21.question: Why did the Prophet fast Mondays?
options: He was born on Monday, and revealation was sent to him first on that day
Deeds presented that day, so maximum rewards
It is sunnah only for the prophets
To make up missed fasts, and prepare for the next year
sawm-easy-21.explanation: It was the day on which I was born. on which I was commissioned with prophethood or revelation was sent to me,

sawm-easy-22.question: What is the ruling on kissing without lust during fasting?
options: Permissible if there is no fear of ejaculation

sawm-easy-23.question: Who is exempt from fasting in Ramadan?

sawm-easy-24.question: What is Zakat al-Fitr?
sawm-easy-24.explanation: Paid at end of Ramadan to allow poor to celebrate.

sawm-easy-25.question: When is the best time for suhur?
sawm-easy-25.explanation: Delay it as much as possible.

sawm-easy-26.question: What invalidates the fast besides eating?
sawm-easy-26.explanation: Intentional acts that reach throat or smoke.

sawm-easy-27.question: What is the punishment for missing fast without excuse?

sawm-easy-28.question: Which night to seek Laylat al-Qadr?
sawm-easy-28.explanation: Search in odd nights of last ten days of Ramadan.

sawm-easy-29.question: What is the sign of Laylat al-Qadr?
sawm-easy-29.explanation: It is peaceful, no one hears a voice until dawn.

sawm-intermediate-1.question: According to the hadith, what is exclusively for Allah in reward?
sawm-intermediate-1.explanation: Fasting is done for Allah, and He alone gives its reward.

sawm-intermediate-2.question: What happens to devils in Ramadan?
sawm-intermediate-2.explanation: Gates of Hell closed, devils chained in Ramadan.

sawm-intermediate-3.question: How many branches of faith include haya, related to fasting modesty?
sawm-intermediate-3.explanation: Faith has over sixty branches, haya being one, important for fasters.

sawm-intermediate-4.question: What is the kaffarah for breaking fast intentionally?
options: Free slave and fast two months
sawm-intermediate-4.explanation: Kaffarah is freeing a slave, or fasting two consecutive months, or feeding sixty poor.

sawm-intermediate-5.question: Can a fasting person use miswak?
sawm-intermediate-5.explanation: The Prophet used miswak while fasting.

sawm-intermediate-6.question: What is the time for iftar?
sawm-intermediate-6.explanation: Break fast as soon as sun sets.

sawm-intermediate-7.question: Is fasting on Ashura obligatory?
sawm-intermediate-7.explanation: It is sunnah, expiates previous year.

sawm-intermediate-8.question: What is i'tikaf?
sawm-intermediate-8.explanation: Recommended in last ten days of Ramadan.

sawm-intermediate-9.question: Who can give Zakat al-Fitr?
sawm-intermediate-9.explanation: On behalf of self and dependents.

sawm-intermediate-10.question: When must Zakat al-Fitr be paid by?

sawm-intermediate-11.question: What amount for Zakat al-Fitr?
sawm-intermediate-11.explanation: One sa' of staple food like dates or barley.

sawm-intermediate-12.question: Is voluntary fasting allowed in Ramadan?
sawm-intermediate-12.explanation: Ramadan fast is obligatory, no extra nafl in it.

sawm-intermediate-13.question: What if menstruating during Ramadan?
sawm-intermediate-13.explanation: Women make up missed days after purity.

sawm-intermediate-14.question: Can a traveler fast in Ramadan?
sawm-intermediate-14.explanation: Traveler can break and make up later.

sawm-intermediate-15.question: What is the dua for iftar?
sawm-intermediate-15.explanation: Dua at breaking fast is not rejected.

sawm-intermediate-20.question: When to perform i'tikaf?
sawm-intermediate-20.explanation: Sunnah in last ten of Ramadan.

sawm-intermediate-21.question: Can one leave mosque in i'tikaf for Jumu'ah?

sawm-intermediate-22.question: What is the virtue of fasting Arafah?

sawm-intermediate-23.question: Is fasting on Friday alone recommended?
sawm-intermediate-23.explanation: Fasting only Friday is disliked unless with Thursday or Saturday.

sawm-intermediate-24.question: What is the month of patience?
sawm-intermediate-24.explanation: Ramadan is the month of patience.

sawm-intermediate-25.question: Who narrated about suhur blessing?
sawm-intermediate-25.explanation: Anas narrated 'Take suhur, blessing in it.'

sawm-intermediate-26.question: What invalidates fast but no kaffarah?

sawm-intermediate-27.question: Is blood donation allowed while fasting?

sawm-intermediate-28.question: What is the best dua time during fast?

sawm-intermediate-31.question: How to confirm moon sighting for Ramadan?

sawm-intermediate-32.question: Is it allowed to fast for deceased?
sawm-intermediate-32.explanation: Fasting cannot be done on behalf of dead.

sawm-advanced-1.explanation: Gates of Prayer, Rayyan for fasting, Charity, Jihad.

sawm-advanced-12.question: Hadith on three whose fast not accepted?
sawm-advanced-12.explanation: Their fast not accepted until repent.

sawm-advanced-13.question: Is voluntary fast on doubted day allowed?
sawm-advanced-13.explanation: Do not fast day of doubt.

sawm-advanced-16.question: Hadith narrator for 'Ramadan comes as mercy'?
sawm-advanced-16.explanation: O people of faith, month of Ramadan.

sawm-advanced-17.question: What is consensus on fasting for pregnant?
sawm-advanced-17.explanation: Fear harm to self or child.

sawm-advanced-25.question: Hadith on 'month of Quran'?
sawm-advanced-25.explanation: Gabriel reviews Quran with Prophet in Ramadan.

sawm-advanced-26.question: What if vomit returns to mouth?
sawm-advanced-26.explanation: If cannot spit, swallow doesn't break.

sawm-advanced-30.question: Advanced: Consensus on intention for fast?
sawm-advanced-30.explanation: Intention once at beginning for whole month.

sawm-advanced-32.explanation: Fasting most beloved deed to Allah.
